title: Supply Stacks
description: Simulate a crane rearranging crate stacks with two movement modes.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse the crate diagram into lists (bottom to top) and extract move instructions as `(count, source, destination)` triples.

## Part 1

The CrateMover 9000 moves crates one at a time, effectively reversing their order. Pop from source and push to destination, repeated `count` times.

## Part 2

The CrateMover 9001 moves all crates at once, preserving order. Slice the top `count` crates from source and extend the destination stack.
